turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
**No, we cannot.**

The 5-litre silicone gaskets (`GSK-SIL-05L`) are marked as food-contact items in the item master. Under Rasoi's **Purchase Policy §6.2** (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and **Supplier Policy §4.1** (POL-SUP-003 §4.1):

- Parts that come into contact with food (including gaskets, lids, and body blanks) may **only** be purchased from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi.
- The certificate must be uploaded and verified before an order can be placed.
- Even if their pricing is significantly better, policy strictly prohibits placing orders for food-contact parts with uncertified suppliers (or suppliers with expired certificates).

- **Food-contact items** (such as gaskets, lids, body blanks, or any item flagged as food-contact in Bahi) **cannot be ordered** from a supplier without a valid food-grade certificate on file.
- The certificate must be uploaded and verified in Bahi **before** an order is placed.
- Note that Bahi does not automatically block purchase orders to suppliers without certificates (POL-SUP-003 §4.7), so the responsibility falls on the buyer and approver to ensure compliance.

If you are ordering a **non-food-contact** item, a food-grade certificate is not required.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.7 Bahi does not stop an order to a supplier without a certificate. The check in this section is done by the person raising the order, and by the approver.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.5 An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no food-contact part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked.

clauses.heading: 4. Food-grade certificates
clauses.text: 4.1 A supplier of any part that comes into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) must hold a food-grade certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2.

clauses.heading: 6. Supplier qualification
clauses.text: 6.2 **Parts that come into contact with food** (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a **valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked **before the first order** is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate.
